releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.1 — OmniFrameGen 2X FPS Doubling Hub:
- OmniFrameGen 2X/3X Frame Multiplier Hub: Dedicated control center in GPU Profiles supporting NVIDIA Optical Flow (DLSS 3), AMD FSR 3, Lossless Scaling (LSFG), and AeroPacing 72->144Hz smooth scanout.
- NVIDIA Reflex Ultra Low Latency Integration: System profile scheduler tuning and 1.0ms MMIO precision timer to eliminate input lag.
- In-Game Overlay FrameGen Indicator: Live tracking of 2X FrameGen active status and display refresh rate.
